original_method: None approved. Engineering must provide nvbandwidth artifact/version, GPU/topology identity, exact required test rows (for example device-to-device and direction), sizes/modes/concurrency/runtime, units/statistic, per-path thresholds/tolerance and health/abort/recovery. review_improvement: Keeps a placeholder SPEC from being converted into an arbitrary long GPU bandwidth run or unverifiable result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bandwidth values are only meaningful for a named source/destination path and transfer mode. Without the required rows and topology-specific ceiling, a high aggregate number can still mask a failed link and cannot support a verdict.
